subject: english
stem: Text: Jay used a paper map after his phone battery died. What is supported?
options: The phone fell into the sea
The paper map remained usable without phone power

optionRationales.reason: Paper maps are always better：一次情境不能推 always。
The phone fell into the sea：原因是 battery died，未提 sea。
The paper map remained usable without phone power：電池死後仍 use paper map。
Jay hates all phones：偏好未提。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「合理推論能逐步連迴文本，猜測需加入未提供的新前提」可推出 The paper map remained usable without phone power；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The paper map remained usable without phone power 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
